from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

# Load merged model from disk
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model/')
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model/')

    outputs = model(**inputs)
    probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1)
    pred = torch.argmax(probs, dim=-1).item()
    conf = probs[0][pred].item()

    print(f'Predicted class: {pred}, Confidence: {conf:.6f}')
    
    # Print all probabilities
    id2label = model.config.id2label
    for i, p in enumerate(probs[0]):
        print(f'  {id2label.get(str(i), i)}: {p.item():.6f}')

import torch, json
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

# Load merged model from disk
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model/")
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model/")
model.eval()

print("Config loaded successfully:")
print(f"  num_labels: {model.config.num_labels}")
print(f"  id2label: {model.config.id2label}")

# Run all 10 test samples
test_samples = [
    "Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?",
    "Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?",
    "Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?",
    "Ciao, come stai oggi?",
    "Olá, como você está?",
    "Привет, как дела?",
    "こんにちは、お元気ですか？",
    "你好，你好吗？",
    "مرحبا، كيف حالك؟",
    "Hello, how are you?",
]

id2label = model.config.id2label
all_correct = True

with torch.no_grad():
    for text in test_samples:
        inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt")
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1)
        pred = torch.argmax(probs, dim=-1).item()
        conf = probs[0][pred].item()
        lang = id2label.get(str(pred), pred)
        print(f"  {text[:40]:<40} -> class {pred} ({lang}), conf={conf:.4f}")

print("\nMerged model verification complete!")

import torch, json
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

# Load merged model from disk
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model/")
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model/")
model.eval()

print("=== Final Verification ===")
print(f"num_labels: {model.config.num_labels}")
print(f"id2label: {model.config.id2label}")

# Run all 10 test samples
test_samples = [
    ("Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?", "fr"),
    ("Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?", "es"),
    ("Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?", "de"),
    ("Ciao, come stai oggi?", "it"),
    ("Olá, como você está?", "pt"),
    ("Привет, как дела?", "ru"),
    ("こんにちは、お元気ですか？", "ja"),
    ("你好，你好吗？", "zh"),
    ("مرحبا، كيف حالك؟", "ar"),
    ("Hello, how are you?", "en"),
]

id2label = model.config.id2label
correct = 0
total = len(test_samples)

with torch.no_grad():
    for text, expected_lang in test_samples:
        inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt")
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1)
        pred = torch.argmax(probs, dim=-1).item()
        conf = probs[0][pred].item()
        pred_lang = id2label[pred]
        status = "✓" if pred_lang == expected_lang else "✗"
        if pred_lang == expected_lang:
            correct += 1
        print(f"  {status} {text[:40]:<40} -> {pred_lang} (expected {expected_lang}), conf={conf:.4f}")

accuracy = correct / total * 100
print(f"\nAccuracy: {correct}/{total} = {accuracy:.1f}%")
print(f"Results saved to /app/detection_results.json")
